body.statement: If \(m\) is odd, then \(C_m(x,y)>0\) for every \((x,y)\ne(0,0)\) and \(C_m(0,0)=0\). If \(m\) is even, then \(C_m(x,y)=0\) if and only if \(x=-y\).
body.justification: The zero set supplies the sharp parity-specific collision geometry.
body.gap: Classical root algorithms note singular recurrences but do not translate their zero locus into a causal identification frontier.
body.consumer: It tells a data analyst which persistence configurations require the exact fallback rather than the closed-form recursion.
